text:
sophie: quick design question — for org-level billing view, do we prefer a compact left-side pane for scope + token breakdown or a full-width stacked card approach? trying to balance glanceability vs discoverability.
jamal: leaning side pane. keeps timeline and charts uninterrupted. also easier to pin scope while scrolling.
kevin: side pane is nice but mobile/compact widths get messy. stacked cards degrade better on small screens.
maria: accessibility note — if we do a side pane we need clear focus order and a skip link. 
kevin: +1 on skip link. also ensure the pane has `role="region" aria-label="Billing scope and token breakdown"` so screen readers announce it.
sophie: good call. what about density? side pane could be compact rows with small sparklines; stacked cards would be more verbose with totals and CTA buttons.
jamal: my worry with stacked cards is users won't realize the token breakdown is collapsible. we lose discoverability for invoice download and project filters.
sophie: suggestion: keep side pane for desktop, fallback to a collapsible top accordion on mobile. show a subtle animation so collapse state is obvious.
maria: microcopy tweak for the invoice CTA: change "Download" to "Download invoice (CSV)"? some customers expect PDF by default. maybe offer two options.
kevin: maybe primary CTA "Download invoice" opens a menu: PDF / CSV / Line-item export. keeps UI clean.
design-bot: Figma snapshot uploaded — https://figma.com/file/xyz123 — has both variants (pane + stacked).
jamal: about charts: prefer a compact area sparkline for per-project tokens and a larger stacked area for org total. that preserves trend context.
maria: contrast: token badges (blue/green/purple) fail WCAG AA at small sizes. need bolder borders or labels.
sophie: can we use patterns + color to encode project groups, not just color? helps colorblind users.
kevin: keyboard nav: ensure token breakdown items are tabbable, hitting Enter expands details; Esc collapse. also aria-expanded state on the toggles.
maria: invoice accessibility: for the invoice modal, trap focus and include a descriptive header: "Invoice for March 2026 — Redwood Inference".
jamal: nit: wording on scope switcher — current copy "Switch scope" sounds technical. Maybe "View account or project billing" or two explicit tabs: "Account | Project".
sophie: love the explicit tabs. reduces cognitive load. default to Account when user is org admin, else Project.
design-bot: design note added to Figma: default behavior + keyboard interactions + CTA menu.
sophie: action items: kevin — prototype focus/skip link behavior; jamal — mobile accordion copy & animation; maria — accessibility contrast fixes and invoice modal copy. I'll schedule a 20m sync after prototypes are up. :zap:
kevin: on it, aiming for a quick prototype by EOD tomorrow.
maria: will draft copy and aria snippets by EOD too.
jamal: will mock mobile accordion states and include micro-interaction notes.
sophie: thanks all — keeping thread concise, will follow up with Figma link and meeting invite. :calendar:
